eyebrow: A grid of axes with shared scales
code:
fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    1, 2, sharey=True,
    figsize=(9, 3.6))
axes[0].bar(means.index, means.values)
axes[1].bar(by_region.index,
            by_region.values)
axes[0].set_title("By segment")
axes[1].set_title("By region")
caption: sharey=True keeps the comparison honest.

code:
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5),
                 layout="constrained")
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 3)
ax_trend = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ax_seg = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_hist = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax_sc = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
fig.suptitle("Retail overview")
caption: gs[0, :] spans the whole top row.

code:
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly import subplots
fig = subplots.make_subplots(
    rows=1, cols=2)
fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=names, y=vals),
              row=1, col=1)
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=x, y=y,
              mode="markers"),
              row=1, col=2)
caption: Each trace gets a row and column.
